examples.text: Seine unbegründete Ablehnung war für die anderen Mitglieder des Komitees unerklärlich.

glosses: Having no strong foundation; not based on solid reasons or facts.

examples.text: […] my chiefest design ever since the seventeenth year of my age […] consisted in elaborating such demonstrations in Natural Philosophy, as might serve to unfold the natures of Beings in relation to the Art of Physick, hitherto so uncertain, blind, and unfounded on Art […]
[…] such unfounded conjectures are best answered by neglect.
The gloom of her first anticipations was proved to have been unfounded.
“He give a name,” said Mrs. Hall—an assertion which was quite unfounded—“but I didn’t rightly hear it.”
[…] the allegation that his lordship never allowed Jewish people to enter the house or any Jewish staff to be employed is utterly unfounded […]

glosses: Not having been founded or instituted.

examples.text: Even the great world as yet undiscovered, the cities as yet unfounded, and the history as yet unwritten, are lost: fallen from the beginning.

[…] from them I go
This uncouth errand sole, and one for all
My self expose, with lonely steps to tread
Th’ unfounded deep […]

He makes this Glob so spacious and fair
Unfix’d, unprop’d, unfounded any where,
Hang, like a Water-bubble in the Air.

glosses: Sans fondement, qui ne repose sur rien.

examples.text: La rumeur qu’il était mort se révéla infondée.
Mais, moi, j’avais vu la vache bleue. Je l’ai défendue, mais personne ne m’a crue non plus. Tout le monde m’a accusée de dire des choses infondées.

glosses: adj. 无理由的，无根据的，站不住脚的
